description: Spotify Web API from your terminal: search, recommendations, playlists, playback control, library, and listening history, with --json output on every read command for AI agents.
rules: Install as @crafter/spoti-cli, not spoti-cli; the binary is still spoti-cli
Authenticate first with spoti-cli auth --client-id <id>; the Spotify app redirect URI must be exactly http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback
Pass --json when output will be parsed by a program or agent
403 errors usually mean the user is not in the Spotify app's User Management allowlist
